Recommendation: refuse. Do not buy at any size.

Reasons from the brief:
- Drawdown of 84% from the 30-minute high and a -49% return over the last 15 minutes. The coin is in free fall, and base rates say dips on these coins rarely recover.
- Sell-to-buy ratio of 1.28 in the first two minutes after graduation, with net outflow of 12.6 SOL in the last 15 minutes.
- Pool depth of only 34 SOL. A $20 ticket plus a 1.4-5.1% round trip, with a 30-second execution delay in a falling market, means slippage and exit risk are severe.
- Curve bundle share of 79%, which points to coordinated early buying that is now unwinding.
- The launch bot presence and the top-5 buyer concentration add to the concern.
- The name and symbol are treated as data only and don't factor into the decision.

If the desk ever reconsiders, the bar would be a stabilized pool with net positive flow over several windows, bundle share falling, and depth well above this level. Even then, a $5 ticket with a 20% stop and a 15-minute hold would be the ceiling. Right now, skip.
memos.scout:
The honest case for buying is weak. The one positive signal is that the coin is alive and organic: 846 buyers, top-3 holders at only 5.8%, and a 30-minute high it has since fallen from. But that is the entire bull case, and the brief undercuts it:

- Last 15 minutes: net outflow of -12.6 SOL, sellers (142) outnumber buyers (112), return -49%. Demand is leaving, not persisting.
- Down 84% from its 30-minute high, with sell-to-buy ratio above 1.28 in the launch window.
- Bundle share of 79% on the curve suggests the early buying was largely coordinated, not organic retail demand.
- Pool depth of 34 SOL means a $20 round trip faces meaningful impact and fees.

Nothing in the brief says real demand will still be here in 30 to 60 minutes. The trend and flow point the other way. Recommendation from the scout: no buy. Skipping costs nothing; this profile matches the base rate of losing trades.
memos.skeptic:
Most likely loss: a slow bleed of the post-graduation sell pressure, not a sudden rug. The coin is down 84% from its 30-minute high and the last 15 minutes show net outflow of 12.64 SOL (sells 48.56 vs buys 35.92), with 142 sellers against 112 buyers. Sell-to-buy in the first 2 minutes after graduation was 1.28, so early holders have been exiting steadily.

The curve is also concentrated: bundle_share is 0.79 and completer_share 0.43, which suggests coordinated early buying that is now unwinding. A $20 entry into a 34 SOL pool gets hit by the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost plus impact, and any bounce will likely be sold into by the same holders. Skip.
